name: forge
description: Tooling that wraps the FORGE framework (Framework for Objective-Rooted, Gated Execution) — compose, revise, and review instructions an AI agent can execute without interpretation. Every gap a human leaves is a judgment call handed to the agent; forge closes those gaps in interactive Q&A or best-efforts them in headless mode, and grades the result for how well an agent will understand it and the risk that execution diverges from intent.
